journey.name: pending wallet recovery admission
journey.description: Use a disposable test-network recovery fixture with synthetic funds and a complete wallet backup containing an unresolved payment attempt and private address reservation ceilings. A VSS control must fail or delay wallet download/import without preventing node sync, and a separate control must fail Pubky profile caching after wallet restoration succeeds. These full-app fault controls are not currently provisioned; repository tests and Compose component tests are separate evidence. iOS already keeps its normal startup behind the durable restore gate and presents retry-only recovery failure. Android keeps node sync and reservation reveal available because restore needs them. Never reset a real wallet or use live funds.

actions.action: Start restoring the fixture wallet and fail required wallet backup download
Retry more than twice and verify Try Again remains available without Proceed Without Backup
Attempt ordinary BTC and Lightning sends, a new receive address and a prepared broadcast through the fixture; verify no new operation is signed or broadcast while required recovery is pending
Restart the app with the same pending restore and verify the same admission restrictions remain
Restore backup availability, trigger overlapping retries and verify one restoration completes before wallet actions become available
Repeat with successful wallet recovery followed by profile cache failure; after repeated failures verify Proceed is available only while safety markers are clear
Set a pending restore marker before confirming Proceed and verify the current state is rechecked and recovery cannot be dismissed
